reasons: Claimed status is compliant, and no redline or comment was proposed — consistent with the expectation that compliant findings are recorded as evidence rather than negotiated.

Cited text supports the conclusion: p0118 gives Sparkling (Customer) a 90-day termination-for-convenience right with no termination fee or minimum commitment; p0084 is a plain obligation to pay Fee Schedule fees with no penalty, minimum or LD mechanic; p0128 runs money in the Customer's favour (perpetual licence conversion plus refund by Garman).

No Customer-payable liquidated damages, penalty or early-termination charge is present in the cited clauses, so the preferred position ('no liquidated damages or penalties payable by Customer') is met and no edit is warranted.
Deterministic checks are empty and the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs, confirming no unintended textual change.
